title: Turkish Culinary Culture
summary: Turkish: cumin and mint, bulgur, olive oil.
origins: Turkish cuisine reflects middle east geography, trade routes, and home cooking traditions passed through generations.
history: Shared plates, warm spices, and balance of grain, legume, and herb.
teaching: Toast spices, use yogurt and tahini for richness, finish with fresh herb and pomegranate acid.
Sumac, zaatar, bulgur, chickpeas, and flatbread are pantry anchors.
Signature pairing: cumin and mint + bulgur + olive oil.
